observations: One photo only: a narrow white upright appliance with a grey top lid, shot indoors.
Photo 0 shows a sticker on the front reading 'NEXUS'.
Shape is a single tub top loading washing machine; no second tub or second lid is visible.
The lid and any control knobs or panel are hidden under a pile of clothes, so the controls cannot be seen.
A power cord runs from the top and another cable trails on the floor; no model or rating plate is visible.
Body shows scuffing and dirt on the lower base; no cracks visible on the front face.
No photo of the inside of the drum, the agitator, the drain hose or the machine running.

identity.kind: single tub top load washing machine
read_from: photo 0 front sticker (brand only, model not visible)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a Nexus single tub washing machine; availability and location cannot be checked from a photo but the item itself matches.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on, wash or spin; no evidence of it working.
risks.proof: A short clip of the machine plugged in, filling and the agitator turning, then spinning.

risks.risk: Capacity and model unknown; model plate not shown.
risks.proof: A clear close photo of the rating plate on the back or side showing model and kg capacity.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest Nexus single tub capacity

risks.risk: Lid, timer knobs or control panel may be broken or missing, hidden under clothes.
risks.proof: A photo of the top with the clothes removed and the lid open, showing knobs and the drum inside.
risks.if_unproven: as with damaged lid and controls

risks.risk: Leaking tub, cracked inner drum or worn drain hose not visible.
risks.proof: A clip of the machine filled with water standing on a dry floor for a few minutes, and a photo of the drain hose.

risks.risk: Photo may not be of the seller's own machine.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine with a handwritten note of today's date and the seller's name placed on it.
risks.if_unproven: priced only on the agent's inspection before payment

proof_requests: Clip of the machine plugged in, filling, washing and spinning.
Close photo of the rating plate showing model and capacity.
Photo of the top with clothes removed and lid open, showing knobs and drum.
Photo of the drain hose and the base, and a leak check clip.
Photo with a handwritten note of today's date on the machine.
response.reason: The brand Nexus is readable on the front sticker and the shape is a single tub washing machine, so it can be priced at its worst case as not working and smallest capacity until proof of function and the rating plate arrive.
